evidence.detail: Class extends Renderable and binds directly to R28 SpotAnimationDefinition by spot-animation id; it also follows the linked SequenceDefinition frames.
Instance stores world/location/cycle state, current frame/time and finished state; its update method advances sequence frames and its model method applies the current spot-animation frame.
Role matches the classic stationary spot-animation / still-graphic entity; GraphicsObject is the modern semantic name for this exact scene object.

candidates.note: GraphicsObject is chosen as the clear modern semantic name for the stationary spot-animation renderable.

evidence.detail: Class extends Renderable, stores item id and quantity, resolves R28 ItemDefinition by id and requests the quantity-aware item Model.
Client constructs this type for items placed on ground/tile item lists.
Structure matches the classic ground-item renderable historically often named Item or ItemPile element; GroundItem avoids ambiguity with ItemDefinition.

candidates.note: GroundItem distinguishes the world entity from the item definition/cache object.

evidence.detail: Class extends Renderable and owns double-precision x/y/z position, horizontal/vertical velocity, speed and acceleration state.
Trajectory setup computes horizontal distance, per-tick velocities, vertical slope and acceleration; updates use atan2 for yaw/pitch and advance spot-animation sequence frames.
Projectile rendering binds directly to R28 SpotAnimationDefinition and its SequenceDefinition.

candidates.note: Projectile is fixed by the ballistic trajectory and spot-animation rendering behavior.

evidence.detail: Class extends Renderable, stores object id/type/orientation/tile-height state and resolves R28 ObjectDefinition for model construction.
Optional SequenceDefinition state advances by client cycle time before model construction.
Class preserves varbit/config-driven morph metadata from ObjectDefinition and resolves the active object definition before rendering.

candidates.note: DynamicObject reflects the exact animated/morphing world-object role.
